mapper.update: UPDATE COMPANY_USERS SET COMPANY_NAME = #{cName}, COMPANY_REGISTRATION = #{cRegistration}, COMPANY_PHONE = #{cPhone}, COMPANY_SIZE = #{cSize}, COMPANY_REGION = #{cRegion} WHERE COMPANY_IDX = #{cIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY_EMAIL as cEmail, COMPANY_NAME as cName, COMPANY_REGISTRATION as cRegistration, COMPANY_PHONE as cPhone, COMPANY_SIZE as cSize, COMPANY_REGION as cRegion FROM COMPANY_USERS WHERE COMPANY_IDX = #{cIdx}
